Slop Time

World clock, meeting planner and time zones, with no network sync.

Open Slop Time Back to Slop Drive

About Slop Time

Slop Time shows the time in the cities you choose, works out the time difference between two zones, and plans a meeting across zones by finding the hours when everyone is inside working hours. A planned meeting can be added to Slop Calendar as a meeting. The clock follows your device, with a manual offset you can set. Nothing is uploaded and nothing syncs from the network.
